verdict.rationale: Pipecat documents first-party capture of both sides of the conversation: AudioBufferProcessor records user and bot audio, and turn events collect user and assistant messages for transcripts. However, these are in-pipeline capture features; there is no documented hosted store or API to retrieve recordings and transcripts after the fact, so the developer must persist them for every call. Missing for 10: documented programmatic retrieval API or storage for recordings and transcripts (e.g., via the Pipecat Cloud REST API), guaranteed per-call coverage, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can retrieve full call recordings and transcripts programmatically for every call

citations.quote: Pipecat's \`AudioBufferProcessor\` makes it easy to capture high-quality audio recordings of both the user and bot during interactions.
Pipecat's turn events make it easy to collect both user and assistant messages as they occur.
